behavior: A user creates profiles and receives money in the app: receive address, QR, balances, activity
acceptance: Creating a freelancer or merchant profile adds it to the switcher with its own wallet; the profile page shows the receive address with a QR code and an exact network and token warning
The page shows balances (estimated total marked, pending and held separate) and activity, with empty states for a new profile; axe finds 0 serious or critical violations
notes: 2026-10-09 review fail by reviewer: Round-1 web findings fixed and verified (request rows unsigned, warning-gated receive panel, honest copy, paging, useLoad, tests, kit). New backend issues from the fixes: (1) POST /v1/me now retries every walletless profile's Privy wallet one after another, each up to privy.Timeout 20s, inside the api's 30s WriteTimeout (profile.go SignUp loop). If Privy hangs, every app load waits 20s per broken profile, and with 2+ broken profiles /v1/me times out, so the whole app shows 'We could not load your profiles' even though the personal wallet is fine. Bound the non-personal repair (one short shared deadline, or skip it on /v1/me and retry elsewhere). (2) If Privy fails during POST /v1/profiles, the server stores the profile and answers 500. The form says 'We could not create the profile', and since changed values now get a new key, an edited retry creates a second profile; the first appears after reload. Return the stored profile (walletAddress null) instead of 500, or tell the user the profile exists.

2026-10-09 review pass by reviewer: Round-2 fixes verified. SignUp: the personal wallet keeps the request context; other profiles' wallet repairs share one 5 s RepairBudget, tested with a slow Privy fake. Create: a wallet failure returns the profile with walletAddress null instead of 500, so an edited retry can't make a second profile; the next /v1/me makes the wallet (tested). Earlier web findings stay fixed: unsigned invoice rows, receive panel shown only with its network/token warning, honest copy, one-request paging, useLoad drops stale answers, render tests, /kit. Profile, httpapi and activity Go tests pass.
